Message.Name: Top Of Book Message
Message.Description: Generated when the top price level has been modified. There are no New, Change or Delete actions for Top Of Book: whenever the price, quantity or number of orders at the top of book changes a new message is sent. When an order book is emptied as a result of market activity, a Top Of Book message is sent with the price fields null and the aggregate quantity and number of orders zero. The TimeOfEvent is the latest incoming event timestamp regardless of the event that caused the update; for orders submitted during Pre-Open and reloaded GTC and GTD orders it reflects the uncrossing event time at market open.

Field.Name: TimeOfEvent
Field.Description: The time LMEselect updated the order book, triggering a Top Of Book message.

Field.Name: AggregateBidVolume
Field.Description: Aggregated quantity available on the bid side.

Field.Name: AggregateAskVolume
Field.Description: Aggregated quantity available on the ask side.

Field.Name: BidPrice
Field.Description: The bid price, in implicit six decimal place format.

Field.Name: AskPrice
Field.Description: The ask price, in implicit six decimal place format.

Field.Name: NumberBidExplicitOrders
Field.Description: The total number of bid orders in the best price level for explicit orders.

Field.Name: BidQtyExplicitOrders
Field.Description: The total quantity of bid orders in the best price level for explicit orders.

Field.Name: NumberAskExplicitOrders
Field.Description: The total number of ask orders in the best price level for explicit orders.

Field.Name: AskQtyExplicitOrders
Field.Description: The total quantity of ask orders in the best price level for explicit orders.

Field.Name: NumberBidImpliedOrders
Field.Description: The total number of bid orders in the best price level for implied orders.

Field.Name: BidQtyImpliedOrders
Field.Description: The total quantity of bid orders in the best price level for implied orders.

Field.Name: NumberAskImpliedOrders
Field.Description: The total number of ask orders in the best price level for implied orders.

Field.Name: AskQtyImpliedOrders
Field.Description: The total quantity of ask orders in the best price level for implied orders.
